notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: נביא... nɔnabila te sɔrɔ — תשעני kuntilen-fɔ 'i' de ye; Bamanankan b'a wajibiya ka ⟨i⟩ bilali ka kuma-clear don

notes.subject: jugu
notes.rationale: חמס ye 'jugu-kɛli / hakilijuguya' ye; 'jugu' ta ye nɔgɔya la n'a bɛɛ bɛ faamu

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: kumasen in laban Yawe ma — 'i bɛ ne lasoɔgɔ bɔ'

notes.subject: צורי אלהי
notes.rationale: min bɛ bɔ cogo min na: 'Elohim, ne ka kabala' (sinsin-construct) walima 'ne ka kabala Elohim' (geneva: 'God is my strength'); an ye construct tilannen ta

translation: Elohim, ne ka kabala — ne bɛna a bolo kɔlɔsi; ne ka bɛn, ani ne ka lasoɔgɔ gban, ne ka ja-yɔrɔ ani ne ka boli-yɔrɔ; ne ka lasoɔgɔla — ⟨i⟩ bɛ ne lasoɔgɔ bɔ jugu la.
